title: Independent review of forced Drive offhand weapon preparation
scope: Read-only static review of the frozen helper and integration; no game/UI/IDB writes, product changes or independent test build.
result: No blocking finding in the reviewed source versions.

checks.finding: 3E6010 records the 64-byte-rounded payload size at BAR-16, excluding the preceding 16-byte allocation header. Magic 0x23234141 and allocation kind 1 match. 3A6840 establishes encoded self-pointer BAR+8. Helper validates these before bounding table and payload spans.

System BAR global 2AE5E50 owns the first type-2 went/wmst entries. Their decoded data pointers must equal installed globals 2AE5A38/2AE5A40. Entry sizes bound every mapping cell and 32-byte name; payload lies after the entry table and inside the loaded allocation. Link flags do not change first-match selection.

3EF8B0 uses unsigned WORD item+4, not BYTE item+2. Lookup is DWORD index went[group]+itemWORD4. The helper widens before addition/multiplication and checks subtraction-based span bounds. 3EF910 uses 32*(2*group+hand); hand 1 is checked for a nonempty terminated 32-byte name.

Only dual forms 1/4/5 can request replacement. Object character 1/14 and signed form selector +87 tie the plan to the exact 56-byte form record. A valid existing offhand is preserved; fallback is only the currently valid main Keyblade, checked in the target form weapon group. No bag, unlock, level or ability edit is introduced.

Begin re-runs CanStart, Items and PlanFormWeapon immediately before the optional single uint16 write and NativeBegin. The queued Revert-to-base path calls Begin again for the fresh base actor. Rollback occurs only if no native context was created and the slot still equals the fallback; an unexpected live context retains the valid value for native cleanup.

validation.source_review: Completed independently; hashes above identify exact files.
validation.tests: Parent reported central standalone Drive harness: 854 checks, 0 failures, no warnings. This reviewer did not execute a parallel build. The test source hash records the file observed at review freeze, not an independently attested executed binary.
validation.evidence_pagination: Author normalized full-body counts after initial page counters remained at 100. No missing ASM lines were found; the corrected evidence hashes are recorded above.

limitations: Static checks do not prove that arbitrary modified installations contain the named model and MSET files or that their contents are valid.
The allocation bound is the native rounded allocation size, not an independently retained exact file length; individual BAR entry sizes provide the per-table bound.
A successful fallback remains assigned until changed and can persist in a subsequent game save.
The commit relies on the existing validated game-thread lifecycle; it is not a synchronization protocol for arbitrary concurrent third-party memory writes.
No live locked-Final transition was executed by this reviewer.
freeze: Only these independent review files were written. Product source, v0.8 work and released packages remain unchanged.
